T: Stunts all day, prawns by the harbour.
D: A battered stuntman is pulled back onto a film set in Sydney to find the movie's missing star.
P: Serve the prawns when Colt lands the record-breaking cannon roll.
S: Chilled king prawns, horseradish cocktail sauce, buttered white bread
Cooked king prawns on ice with lemon wedges, bread and butter and a quick cocktail sauce.
Grilled sausages in buttered bread with beer onion relish

Thick beef snags grilled until snapping, in buttered bread with sticky caramelised onion and beer relish, mustard and plenty of tomato sauce. Slowly cook 3 sliced onions in 30g butter for 20 minutes until soft and golden. Add 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp balsamic and 60ml beer and simmer 5 minutes until jammy. Grill 8 thick beef sausages on a medium barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through. Butter 8 slices of white bread, wrap each round a sausage and top with the onion relish, mustard and tomato sauce.
a pie between takes on set

Little beef and gravy pies in shortcrust with flaky puff lids, baked golden and served hot with plenty of tomato sauce for the crew. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, 300ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tbsp tomato paste and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Cool. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 12 rounds from 2 shortcrust sheets and press into a greased muffin tin. Fill with the mince, top with rounds cut from 1 puff pastry sheet, press the edges, brush with egg and bake 20 to 25 minutes.
M: Beer-battered flathead fillets with thick double-fried chips

Flathead fillets in a crisp beer batter fried golden with thick-cut chips, lemon wedges and homemade tartare sauce. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips and fry at 150C for 6 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes. Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager into a batter, dip 600g flathead fillets and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 125g mayonnaise with chopped pickles for tartare and serve with lemon.
the catering trays on a long shoot

Slow-cooked beef ragù layered with fresh pasta and nutmeg béchamel, topped with mozzarella and parmesan and baked until bubbling and crisp at the edges. Brown 800g beef mince, add 1 diced onion, 1 carrot and 2 garlic cloves, then 700g passata and 125ml red wine. Simmer 45 minutes. Melt 60g butter, stir in 60g plain flour, whisk in 750ml milk and cook until thick, adding nutmeg and 50g parmesan. Heat the oven to 180C. Layer ragù, 375g fresh lasagne sheets and béchamel three times in a deep dish. Top with 200g mozzarella and bake 45 minutes. Rest 15 minutes.
W: Crisp meringue shell with soft marshmallow centre and cream
Crisp meringue shell with a soft marshmallow middle, cooled in the oven and topped with whipped cream, passionfruit and berries.
K: Iced milk coffee topped with vanilla ice cream and cream

Cold coffee and milk poured over ice with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and whipped cream on top. Brew 500ml strong coffee from 50g ground coffee and chill. Pour into 4 tall glasses with ice and 400ml cold milk, then top each with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and a spoon of whipped cream.

s.note: Chilled king prawns, horseradish cocktail sauce, buttered white bread
s.how: Pile 1kg cooked king prawns on crushed ice with lemon wedges. Mix 125ml tomato sauce with 1 tsp horseradish and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with buttered white bread, the way you would on the harbour.

s.note: Grilled sausages in buttered bread with beer onion relish
s.how: Slowly cook 3 sliced onions in 30g butter for 20 minutes until soft and golden. Add 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp balsamic and 60ml beer and simmer 5 minutes until jammy. Grill 8 thick beef sausages on a medium barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through. Butter 8 slices of white bread, wrap each round a sausage and top with the onion relish, mustard and tomato sauce.

m.note: Beer-battered flathead fillets with thick double-fried chips
m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into chips and fry at 150C for 6 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes. Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager into a batter, dip 600g flathead fillets and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 125g mayonnaise with chopped pickles for tartare and serve with lemon.

w.note: Crisp meringue shell with soft marshmallow centre and cream
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar, shape into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 4 passionfruit and 250g strawberries.

d.note: Iced milk coffee topped with vanilla ice cream and cream
